target_study: Kaiser-Bunbury et al. 2017 Ecosystem restoration strengthens pollination network resilience and function
compilation_title: Data from: Temporal scale-dependence of plant-pollinator networks
source_notes: The compilation explicitly recommends citing/using the original published data wherever possible and lists the original Kaiser-Bunbury 2017 IWDB source. This fallback is used only because the migrated original IWDB host currently fails TLS hostname verification in GitHub Actions.
admission_rule: First recover bytes and verify published MD5s. Then identify the target study from OIK-07303_original_studies.xlsx by exact DOI/source reference before looking at interaction values. Only rows explicitly assigned to that study can be audited for preservation of the 64 source-defined networks and quantitative interaction weights.
claim_boundary: A successful compilation recovery is not automatically equivalent to the original IWDB visitfreq workbook. Primary source-native Tier-B status requires either original bytes or demonstrated preservation of the original study's network identities and quantitative weights; otherwise this remains a secondary validation/fallback layer.
